release: CLASSIC-05 Corp ICE Baseline und Noisy/Sleepy

Bolter Swarm resolves four Net damage and sets the next-encounter no-break marker for the next piece of ICE encountered during the same run.
Brain Drain uses a deterministic six-sided die roll and applies three core damage only on a roll of 1.
Deadeye and Imperial Guard trash an installed Runner program, then resolve End-the-run.
Baskerville, Bolter Swarm, Deadeye and Imperial Guard reduce their own rez cost by five only after noisy Icebreaker use during the current run.
